title: dendranthema littorale subsp. coreanum
intro: Dendranthema littorale subsp. coreanum, commonly known as Korean Chrysanthemum, is a plant species in the sunflower family (Asteraceae) that is native to Korea. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to alleviate symptoms of fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Korean Chrysanthemum include reducing fever, alleviating cough and sore throat, and acting as an antiseptic to prevent infection. The bioactive constituents of Korean Chrysanthemum include flavonoids, terpenoids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often used in traditional Korean medicine to treat various health conditions.
